verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's own registered-agent page says it completes all the paperwork to switch registered agents, pays the state fees, and updates the agent information with the Secretary of State, so the filing half of the story is directly delivered. Nothing in the pack documents the specific change-of-agent form or fee for each state. Missing for 10: per-state documentation of change-of-agent forms and fees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the switch process.

support.subject: As a founder switching providers, the new provider prepares or files the change-of-agent paperwork and documents each state's form and fee

citations.quote: All paperwork needed to switch RAs completed for you, plus state fees covered
we'll pay the fees and take care of that paperwork at no cost to you. We'll also change the registered agent information with your Secretary of State.
